Risk description: An invoice is paid although the goods or services it bills for were never received, or were received at a different quantity or price from the purchase order.
Control objective: Ensure no PO-based invoice is released for payment unless it agrees to the purchase order and the goods receipt note.
Control description: The ERP enforces a mandatory three-way match of invoice, purchase order and goods receipt note before an invoice can be released for payment; tolerance breaches are held and routed to the buyer as an exception.
Design checks (TOD):
The match is enforced by the system and cannot be bypassed by a user
The tolerance the match operates at is documented and approved
A held invoice cannot be released without an approved override
The control leaves an audit trail showing it ran on each invoice
Attributes:
The invoice was matched to a purchase order and a goods receipt note before release
A tolerance breach was held and not released for payment
The match ran on every PO-based invoice in the period

Risk title: Invoice recorded against the wrong entity or vendor
Risk description: A vendor invoice is posted to the wrong legal entity, or against vendor or tax details that do not agree to the vendor master, misstating the payable and the input tax credit.
Control objective: Ensure every vendor invoice is validated against the entity, the vendor master and the purchase order before it is posted.
Control description: The AP team verifies each vendor invoice is addressed to the correct legal entity, carries valid vendor and tax details, references a valid purchase order, and evidences reviewer approval before posting.
Design checks (TOD):
The reviewer is someone other than the person who keyed the invoice
The reviewer has the authority to approve the value of the invoice
The validation is evidenced before the invoice is posted, not after
Attributes:
The invoice was approved by an authorised reviewer before posting
Vendor and tax details on the invoice agree to the vendor master

Risk description: The same vendor invoice is captured and paid more than once because the duplicate check is bypassed or overridden without approval.
Control objective: Ensure a duplicate invoice is blocked before posting, and any override of that block is approved and evidenced.
Control description: The ERP blocks a duplicate invoice on vendor, invoice number, amount and date; any override is recorded on the audit trail and reviewed by the AP lead.
Design checks (TOD):
The duplicate rule covers vendor, invoice number, amount and date together
An override can only be made by someone with the authority to make it
Overrides are reviewed after the fact, not only at the moment they are made
Attributes:
A duplicate invoice was blocked by the system
An override of the duplicate block was approved and evidenced

Risk title: Unapproved vendor added to the master
Risk description: A vendor is created or its bank details changed without independent approval, allowing payment to an unauthorised account.
Control title: Dual approval of vendor master changes
Control objective: Ensure vendor additions and bank-detail changes are independently approved before they take effect.
Control description: Vendor master additions and bank-detail changes require dual approval in the ERP before the record is activated, with the approver independent of the requester.
Design checks (TOD):
The approver is independent of the person requesting the change
The system prevents activation until the second approval is recorded
Attributes:
The vendor change was approved by a second person before activation
The approver was independent of the requester

Risk description: A purchase order is released above the buyer's delegated authority, committing the group to spend nobody approved.
Control title: Purchase order approval per delegation of authority
Control objective: Ensure every purchase order is approved in line with the delegation-of-authority matrix before release.
Control description: Purchase orders are routed for approval against the delegation-of-authority matrix configured in the ERP, and cannot be released until the required approval is recorded.
Design checks (TOD):
The authority limits configured in the system agree to the approved DOA matrix
The workflow cannot be bypassed for an urgent order
Attributes:
The purchase order was approved at the correct authority level before release
The approval was recorded before the order was sent to the vendor

Risk title: Goods recorded as received when they were not
Risk description: A goods receipt note is raised without the goods being physically received or inspected, allowing payment for goods never delivered.
Control title: Goods receipt confirmed against physical inspection
Control objective: Ensure a goods receipt note is raised only after the goods are physically received and inspected.
Control description: Stores staff record a goods receipt note in the ERP only after physical receipt and inspection against the purchase order, with discrepancies logged and routed to the buyer.
Design checks (TOD):
The person raising the receipt is not the person who raised the order
A discrepancy stops the receipt rather than being recorded alongside it
Attributes:
The goods receipt was raised after physical inspection
Quantity received agrees to the purchase order

Risk description: A payment run is released without the authorisation required by the payment authority matrix.
Control objective: Ensure every payment run is authorised by the mandated signatories before release to the bank.
Control description: Payment runs are released to the bank only after authorisation by the signatories named in the payment authority matrix, evidenced in the banking platform's approval log.
Design checks (TOD):
The signatory list in the banking platform agrees to the approved matrix
Two signatories are required above the defined threshold
Attributes:
The payment run was authorised by the mandated signatories before release
The value released agrees to the approved payment proposal

Risk title: Segregation of duties breach in P2P
Risk description: One person can create a vendor, raise a purchase order and release the payment, allowing a fictitious payment to go undetected.
Control objective: Ensure no single user can both post an invoice and approve the payment for it.
Control description: The ERP role design prevents the person who posts an invoice from approving the payment for it; conflicting role combinations are blocked at assignment and reviewed quarterly.
Sub-process: Key Controls and Segregation of Duties
Design checks (TOD):
The conflicting role pairs configured agree to the approved SoD matrix
A conflict cannot be granted without a documented compensating control
Attributes:
No user held both the invoice posting and payment approval roles
Any exception carried an approved compensating control

Risk description: Procurement spend exceeds the approved departmental budget without the overspend being approved.
Control title: Budget availability check before requisition release
Control objective: Ensure a purchase requisition cannot be released where no approved budget remains.
Control description: The ERP checks available budget when a purchase requisition is released and blocks the requisition where the budget is exhausted, unless an overspend approval is recorded.
Design checks (TOD):
The budget the check reads is the approved and released budget
An overspend approval is required from someone with authority for the value
Attributes:
The requisition was blocked where budget was exhausted
An overspend was approved before the requisition was released

Risk title: Invoices not recorded in the correct period
Risk description: Invoices received near period end are posted in the wrong period, misstating payables and expense.
Control objective: Ensure goods received but not invoiced at period end are accrued in the correct period.
Control description: At period end the GR/IR account is reviewed and receipts without an invoice are accrued; the reconciliation is reviewed and signed off by the Financial Controller.
Design checks (TOD):
The review covers the whole GR/IR population, not a selection
The reviewer is independent of the person preparing the accrual
Attributes:
Receipts without an invoice at period end were accrued
The reconciliation was reviewed and signed off before close
